M-STATUS.NAME: Project health status
M-STATUS.purpose: Honest project health snapshot: index counts, status breakdown, lint totals, coded findings and matching exit codes (ADR-3, ADR-8).

fn-buildStatusSnapshot.PURPOSE: Safe aggregation of the three indexes plus lint totals.

fn-statusFindings.PURPOSE: Map index read errors and lint totals to coded findings.

type-StatusSnapshot.PURPOSE: Counts, breakdowns, lint totals and index read errors.

contract.purpose: Honest project health snapshot: index counts, status breakdown, lint totals, coded findings and matching exit codes (ADR-3, ADR-8).

param.name: snapshot
param.description: Totals and breakdowns for modules, phases, verifications and lint.

error.description: Malformed index contents are reported as findings, not crashes.

notes.note-1: Malformed indexes become findings with a non-zero exit code instead of an empty-looking report.
notes.note-2: Text and JSON modes share the same exit-code decision.
notes.note-3: Only the three indexes are needed for a status check, which is what keeps navigation cheap.
